title: Rezzered's MC World
description: A clean, atmospheric survival experience with expanded structures, refined terrain, and efficient automation systems.
body:
![hero](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c96f25a9c39d8077f18480ae82bb76bfefbe28b8.png)

Performance-boosted exploration and tech-driven modpack built on NeoForge. It blends lightweight world expansion with modern tech progression while keeping gameplay smooth and intuitive. The pack enhances terrain with Tectonic, Lithosphere and the full YUNG’s structure suite, creating massive natural landscapes and richer world discovery. Tech Reborn, Industrial Quarry Mod and Applied Energistics 2 provide a complete automation and energy tech loop without overwhelming complexity.

Quality-of-life and visual clarity are improved with mods like Jade, BetterF3, Smooth Scroll, AppleSkin, EntityCulling and FerriteCore. Xaero’s World Map paired with FTB Chunks delivers clean navigation, team play and territory protection. AmbientSounds and Towns & Towers add atmosphere without heavy performance cost.

With Embeddium, Embeddium Extra, Radium and complementary optimization libraries, the pack runs fast even on large bases and heavily-generated worlds. All core mods are chosen for stability, compatibility and a polished vanilla-plus feel, resulting in a world that looks better, plays better and performs better than standard Forge packs.

NeoRez is ideal for players who want better terrain, smarter tech, smoother performance and a more cohesive Minecraft world, without drifting into heavy kitchen-sink complexity.
